inline.please_enter_a_valid_basic_monthly_salar: Please enter a valid basic monthly salary.
inline.please_enter_both_start_and_end_dates: Please enter both start and end dates.
inline.end_date_must_be_after_start_date: End date must be after start date.
inline.estimates_only_final_amounts_depend_on_y: Estimates only. Final amounts depend on your employment contract and free zone authority policies. Not legal advice. Verify with your free zone authority (e.g., JAFZA Labour Affairs) or MOHRE.
inline.difc_operates_the_dews_workplace_savings: DIFC operates the DEWS (Workplace Savings) scheme since Feb 2020. Contributions are calculated monthly at 5.83% (years 1–5) then 8.33% — replacing the traditional lump-sum gratuity.
inline.basic_salary_only_exclude_housing_transp: Basic salary only — exclude housing, transport, commissions, allowances
inline.cap_applied_cannot_exceed_2_years_basic_: Cap applied: cannot exceed 2 years' basic salary.
inline.gratuity_must_be_paid_within_14_days_of_: ⏱ Gratuity must be paid within 14 days of contract end under UAE federal law.
inline.source_federal_decree_law_no_33_of_2021_: Source: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 | DIFC Employment Law 2019 (as amended)
